newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Radioactive hazard found in apartment building.
Price-fixing in public works questioned in provincial legislature.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Macao cooperates in crackdown on Taiwan organised crime groups.
Post Savings cuts term deposit rates.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Tax breaks extended to telecom, electronics, aeronautics, drug companies.
Term deposits jumped in August, anticipating rate cut.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Evergreen to order eight super container ships valued at US$600 million.
Proposed alliance of Yang-ming Marine and Fair Weather of Hong Kong hits snag.
